sized-the-way-twitch-expects-them-ready-: Sized the way Twitch expects them, ready to use. Your link is {URL}, and it lands on your own page on the site.
title: {NAME}'s creator kit
description: unicum.gg visuals for {NAME}: stream overlay, clickable panel and offline screen, ready to use.
overlay-hint: Add it in OBS as an Image source. Transparent background. The top right corner clears the webcam, the minimap and the damage panel.
overlay-compact-hint: The same one without the logo, 36px narrower, if the first takes up too much room.
panel-hint: Use it as a panel under your stream, pointing at your link. It is the only visual anyone can actually click.
offline-hint: Shown on your channel while you are not streaming.
offline-qr: Offline screen with a QR code
offline-qr-hint: The same one with a scannable QR code. Keep it to this screen: inside the video stream, compression makes a QR code unreadable.
